label: From sessions to calls
subgoals: Replace session state with explicit call arguments
Make each operation a function of design handle, parameters and seed
Keep the GUI as a viewer of the shared database

label: What a call must return
subgoals: Return metrics as named numbers with a status
Attach provenance: engine version, parameters and seed
Report failures as structured records of check, object and values

label: Where the compute stays
subgoals: Leave exact computation to the compiled engine
Limit the model to choosing engines, skills and parameters
Trace every number the agent uses back to an engine call
